messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT detected: elevated TLS handshake failures to inference-gateway (eu-west-1). Alert rule: tls_handshake_errors > 5% for 3m. URL: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/1838001234

alex_cheng: oncall here, paging now. Can someone grab network + svc logs? @maria_kline @tariq_shah

jen_lopez: customer reports: multiple tenants in eu-west-1 seeing 502s and connection resets since ~07:05 UTC. Support ticket #42618.

maria_kline: pulling proxy logs + envoy metrics. Initial glance: upstream reset + TLS handshake failures spiking at 07:04. attaching fw tails.

maria_kline: ```
2026-02-22T07:04:12Z gateway-01 envoy [warning] TLS error: handshake failure from 10.20.5.3: remote error: tls: handshake failure
2026-02-22T07:04:12Z gateway-02 envoy [warning] TLS error: EOF during handshake with 10.20.5.4
```

alex_cheng: did we rotate certs overnight in eu-west?

tariq_shah: I see BGP flaps on the VPC peering to model-nodes-eu-azb at ~07:02-07:06, could be route churn. Also seeing MTU mismatch alerts on ENI mtu=9000 vs peer expecting 1500 in the peering path.

maria_kline: that could cause TLS fragments to be lost and handshake to fail. Good catch. Any recent peering changes? @tariq_shah

tariq_shah: ops-team rolled a peering config update for cross-account routing yesterday. I have the terraform change: `aws_vpc_peering_connection.acct-route: add static routes to 10.20.0.0/16`. Not supposed to touch MTU though. Collecting packet captures now.

maria_kline: attaching tcpdump snippet from gateway-01 at 07:04:13:```
07:04:13.123456 IP 10.20.5.3.51234 > 10.30.8.7.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 123 ecr 0], length 0
07:04:13.123789 IP 10.30.8.7.443 > 10.20.5.3.51234: Flags [R.], seq 0, ack 12346, win 0, length 0
07:04:13.124000 IP 10.20.5.3 > 10.30.8.7: ICMP frag needed and DF set (mtu 1500)
```

jen_lopez: so we see MSS 1460 and ICMP fragmentation needed with mtu 1500 while interfaces advertise 9000? weird. Some middlebox trimming frames?

tariq_shah: hypothesis tracker: H1: recent peering change introduced a middlebox with 1500 MTU -> Path MTU blackhole causing TLS handshake fragments dropped = handshake fails. H2: cert rotation produced incompatible certs on a subset of gateways -> SNI mismatch leading to handshake abort. H3: backend nodes overloaded and RST during handshake.

alex_cheng: let's capture openssl s_client to reproduce from gateway to model node and curl with `--no-keepalive` to force full handshake. Also check cert chains.

maria_kline: runs: ```
openssl s_client -connect 10.30.8.7:443 -servername model.internal -tlsextdebug -status
CONNECTED(00000003)
140736... SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to 10.30.8.7:443
---
140736... error:1408A0C1:SSL routines:ssl3_get_client_hello:no shared cipher
```

tariq_shah: that error may be red herring from broken packets. My capture shows repeated retransmits and ICMP frag-needed.

jen_lopez: customer impact note: ~12 customers in EU tenants saw transient 502/timeout, some retries succeeded after 30s. No data corruption. Escalated to enterprise contacts.

rob_neumann: please keep product/sales looped. high priority for enterprise customers on dedicated capacity.

maria_kline: mitigation plan: 1) route traffic for eu-west-1 inference-gateway to fallback AZ (eu-west-1b->eu-west-1c) with known-good peering for 15 min. 2) apply MTU override on affected ENIs to 1500 as quick fix. 3) collect more pcap, then revert. 

alex_cheng: @deploy-bot can we open an emergency route update to shift load to eu-west-1c?

deploy-bot: @alex_cheng deployment queued: canary routing change to divert 20% traffic to eu-west-1c. Approve with `approve deploy 1838001234`

alex_cheng: approve deploy 1838001234

deploy-bot: canary routing change applied: 20% to eu-west-1c at 07:18 UTC. Monitoring.

maria_kline: I pushed MTU change to the three affected ENIs in the peered VPCs (quick CLI): `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500` on gateways 01-03. Confirmed no more frag-needed messages in next 2 minutes.

maria_kline: post-mitigation tcpdump:```
07:20:02.543 IP 10.20.5.3.51234 > 10.30.8.7.443: Flags [S], seq 22345, options [mss 1460], length 0
07:20:02.543 IP 10.30.8.7.443 > 10.20.5.3.51234: Flags [S.], seq 54321, ack 22346, length 0
```

tariq_shah: golden. No ICMP frag-needed now. Latency and 5xx rates trending back to baseline.

jen_lopez: support: customers reported recovery ~07:21-07:25. Sent update to affected customers. No followups yet.

alex_cheng: timeline (in-thread):
- 07:02 UTC: small BGP flaps observed on peering (automated alert)
- 07:04 UTC: tls_handshake_errors spike + customer reports start
- 07:06 UTC: packet captures show ICMP frag-needed -> path MTU issue
- 07:12 UTC: hypothesis list and mitigation plan drafted
- 07:18 UTC: routing canary applied (20% to eu-west-1c)
- 07:19 UTC: MTU override applied to affected ENIs
- 07:21 UTC: TLS handshake success returns, 5xx rate falls
- 07:30 UTC: monitoring stable, incident downgraded to recovery

maria_kline: actions for RCA: - collect full pcaps from all gateways - export envoy handshake traces for affected connections - correlate with peering control-plane logs + terraform change audit - confirm no cert rotation events in same window (I checked certmgr logs: last rotation 2 days ago)

tariq_shah: adding note: we rolled back the recent peering policy patch in the staging account earlier this week for a different bug; maybe a forgetful propagation caused MTU mismatch. I'll open a change-review.

rob_neumann: assign owners for RCA doc: Maria (SRE) -> application/handshake logs and timeline, Tariq (Network) -> peering and MTU root cause, Alex (oncall) -> mitigation replay and runbook updates, Jen -> customer comms.

maria_kline: I will start the in-incident RCA doc in ops docs and paste link: https://ops.redwood.internal/rca/1838001234 (will update with attachments).

jen_lopez: final customer impact summary (to include in RCA): ~12 EU tenants, transient 30s-2m failures, no SLA credits requested yet, proactive email sent.

alex_cheng: handoff: my shift ends in 40m. @maria_kline will carry incident to closure. If anything reappears escalate to oncall chap at +1.

maria_kline: acknowledged. closing monitoring loop, will file postmortem with hypothesis analysis and post-incident actions. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT status: mitigated -> monitoring. Created post-incident ticket PI-6721.
